name: 峰巔風靈
subject: A SUMMIT WIND SPIRIT, a compact humanoid silhouette built from connected desaturated cyan wind ribbons around a dark stone face, two ribbon arms and one tapering swirl below, bronze talisman on chest.

name: 奔雷麒麟
subject: A THUNDER QILIN, complete four-legged Eastern chimera with a deerlike body, short dragon muzzle, single branching golden horn, slate-blue scales, cream mane and a full curling tail.

name: 天嵐之主
subject: A LORD OF SKY STORMS, complete compact wyvern with slate-violet armored scales, two full wing forelimbs and two hind legs, ivory horns, a full curled tail and muted amber membrane seams.

name: 太古戰魂
subject: An ANCIENT BATTLE SOUL, complete floating spectral veteran with a tarnished bronze open-face helmet, pale teal skeletal face, tattered dark red cloak, two gaunt arms and connected ghostly lower shroud; holds one short broken sword.
